## Shared scenes

> When Marilla's amethyst brooch goes missing, she accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invents a dramatic story of losing it so she can attend the picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. Soon after, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and sends her off to enjoy the picnic after all.
>

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), making [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realize how deeply she loves the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and eagerly anticipates returning to school under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically talks to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about her schoolwork and field trips, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains critical. Later, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) proposes organizing a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) embraces wholeheartedly despite Marilla's skepticism and Matthew's encouraging support.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact [Elaine](../character/elaine.md) on a leaky flat boat, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stranded on a bridge pile when the boat sinks. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her in a dory, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly rejects his attempt to apologize and become friends. Back home, after discussing the day's lesson on avoiding over-romanticism with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly encourages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to keep a little romance.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an extra class to prepare advanced students for Queen's entrance examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) join, which delights her. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins her classmates in the new study group, though she regrets Diana's absence and finds herself missing Gilbert's attention despite their fierce academic rivalry.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain intense academic rivals. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, relieved students pack away their studies, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to enjoy her summer before growing up. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her relief over Matthew's health and admitting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has matured.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for her recital at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to offer her own proud yet gruff commentary. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rides to the hotel with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Billy](../character/billy.md), where she experiences severe stage fright before performing. After catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds her courage, gives an outstanding performance that earns an encore, and enjoys the post-concert reception.
>

> After a successful encore and compliment-filled supper, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) head home with [Billy](../character/billy.md). During the ride, [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share compliments and express envy of the wealthy hotel guests, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) asserts her contentment with who she is and the love she has back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who buy her a green evening dress. After moving to town, she attends her first day at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and their [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates, only to face intense homesickness in her boarding house until [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby visit.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles into student life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming new friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while keeping up her academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She spends visits with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and keeps her exams in perspective as commencement approaches.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After graduating, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she notices Matthew's failing health and learns about potential financial trouble with the Abbey Bank. [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) lovingly tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) he is prouder of her than he would be of a dozen boys.
>

> On the eve of beginning their teaching jobs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate whether corporal punishment is ever necessary in school. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) speaks with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also scoffs at her ideal of governing pupils purely through affection. The next morning, a anxious [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) drinks ginger tea prepared by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before setting off to school.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive around canvassing their assigned road to raise money for painting the hall on behalf of the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). They encounter various eccentric neighbors, including grim Miss Eliza, her optimistic sister Catherine, a stressed husband in an apron, and an overly neat Mrs. White.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue their canvassing efforts, encountering a variety of colorful neighbors across [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Upon hearing that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) has just had a newborn son, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) seizes the opportunity to secure a large five-dollar donation from the proud father. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), but he refuses to contribute to the cause.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the hall painting project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before leaving for home. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it has been painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) are initially devastated, but the rest of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) rallies in sympathy and support for them against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>

> In a detailed letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her experiences and humorous anecdotes from teaching her pupils. She shares various amusing classroom incidents and transcripts of letters written by her students, concluding with a imaginative composition by her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate her spring "adopted birthday" with a picnic walk through the woods alongside [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md). On Saturday, the four girls explore new paths, name a woodland pool [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), and discover Hester Gray's forgotten overgrown garden, where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) tells Hester's tragic and romantic story.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) discuss the life and memory of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) while lingering in her garden. Afterwards, they explore the nearby woods and fields, enjoying a lunch by a brook where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) share poetic thoughts on nature and souls before returning home at sunset.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) about Marilla's improving eyesight and the upcoming [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar, then returns home to learn that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) will remain with them through the fall. She recalls disciplining [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for eating forbidden jam, after which she attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) alerts everyone to Judson Parker's plan to rent his fence for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) attempt to talk Judson out of it, but he refuses to change his mind.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) attempt to convince [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to paint advertisements on his fences, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overhears Judson taking a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) near the [Lake of Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-shining-waters). Fearing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) will expose him, Judson agrees to drop the advertisement plan to secure her silence.
>
